clips.title: The story
paras: Around Wellspring Lake, mossy tumors mark Teldrassil's spreading corruption. Carved from the bark and flesh of corrupted timberlings, these poisonous growths show the malevolence taking hold in the young World Tree.

Teldrassil's timberlings were made to nurture and tend the great tree's boughs, but many have grown hostile and diseased. Mossy tumors are signs of that sickness made flesh. Thick with toxins, they spread across the Mire Beasts, Tramplers, and Elder Timberlings around Wellspring Lake. Rellian Greenspyre and the keepers in Darnassus send travelers to cut away the tumors and burn them thoroughly, so their poison cannot take deeper root in the island's soil.
